Name: Torino-X
Overview: Fly a space fighter in this 3D space shooter then switch to a 2D map of space and construct defensive turrets. Buy missiles, machine guns, and lasers to enhance your ship, deploy a variety of defensive assets, and blast your way through 15 levels of intense action. Torino-X combines all aspects of a space fighting simulator and a strategy based turret defense game into one unique platform.
